sources.name: UOKiK Merger Control Decisions
sources.notes: Comprehensive coverage of merger control decisions (koncentracje przedsiebiorstw) from BIP UOKiK. Includes Phase I clearances, Phase II reviews, and conditional/prohibited outcomes.

sources.name: UOKiK Enforcement Decisions
sources.notes: Enforcement decisions (abuse of dominance, cartel, sector inquiries) are not yet ingested. The UOKiK antitrust portal uses a legacy Lotus Notes-based document management system that requires additional scraping work. Decisions are accessible as PDFs but structured data extraction is pending.
